pattern_matches.text: When an order is confirmed, an invoice must be created with a total amount equal to the sum of the unit prices of all products in the order multiplied by their quantities.
Confirming an order reserves the stock quantity of each product in the order by the quantity specified in the order item.
Cancelling a confirmed order releases the reserved stock for each product in the order by subtracting the quantity from the reserved amount.
An order cannot be cancelled if it is not in the confirmed status.
An order cannot be confirmed if it is already confirmed or cancelled.
A product's stock quantity must not go below zero after any reservation or release operation.
A customer can search their orders and invoices by customer_id or by order status.
An administrator can add, update, or delete products and categories, but only if the product's stock quantity is zero or the category exists and is valid.
The total amount in an invoice must match the sum of (unit_price * quantity) for all order items in the corresponding order.
A product must belong to a valid category, as defined by the category_id in the product record.
confirm_order(order_id: int) -> None: Reserves stock for products in the order and creates an invoice. Only allowed for pending orders. Throws InsufficientStockError if stock is insufficient.
cancel_order(order_id: int) -> None: Releases reserved stock for products in the order. Only allowed for confirmed orders. Throws OrderCannotBeCancelledError if order is not confirmed.
ship_order(order_id: int) -> None: Marks an order as shipped. Only allowed for confirmed orders. Throws OrderCannotBeShippedError if order is not confirmed.
